files.review: 957-p4: prepare_dummy_attn builds dummy block tables and state slots for num_reqs_after_padding; execute_model's dummy branch keeps the active num_reqs (when not profiling, without PCP, and when the active requests cover the batch's tokens) and passes the graph's request count as num_reqs_after_padding. #960 round 1: on a non-dummy FULL step with captured metadata (no KV connector, a speculator that does not read the target's metadata) execute_model calls model_state.stage_full_cudagraph_attn(input_batch) instead of prepare_attn. Read together: #960's staging runs only on real steps and stages the real batch (CED floors), never the capture's count; at capture, FULL-mode prepare_attn sizes metadata by num_reqs_after_padding (model_states/default.py), which 957-p4 leaves at the graph's request count, so the captured metadata keeps its padded extent. 957-p4 changes only the active rows of the dummy batch: its tail rows become empty requests (seq_len 0, query_start_loc at num_tokens), the layout prepare_inputs gives a real padded step, and the speculator drafts for the active requests, so the (4, 24) target capture captures the (4, 20) DSpark draft graph (957-p4's functional mark). #965, #980 and #998 round 1 edit add_requests, prepare_inputs, sample_tokens and load_model: different functions. Not settled by reading: a captured kernel whose launch size follows the active count; the boot (no JIT after readiness), the TP3 gate and 957-p4's own capture test settle it.
#964: the stage-1 KV gather and staging barrier (hunks at 195-656); 957-p2: decode stage 2's online-softmax update and the stage-1 identity for inactive segments (hunks at 768-798). Different code.
